description: This file defines a PHP class 'CurrentVersionAPI' that serves as a REST API controller for retrieving and setting the current version of the application during installation or upgrade processes. It handles GET and POST requests to interact with version data, utilizing utility classes and state management components.

classes.name: CurrentVersionAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for retrieving and setting the application's current version during installation or upgrade processes.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch the current application version, either from in-memory state or database, and sets HTTP status if database info is missing.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to set the current application version based on input data.
